title: Wrong database password after a deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API as the broken part, a configuration error with credentials, and ties it to the redeployment of version 2.3.2.
root_cause: The API container was redeployed as version 2.3.2 with incorrect PostgreSQL credentials for user 'shop', causing authentication failures on every product request.
truth: api 2.3.2 reads the database password from a new setting that was never filled in, so PostgreSQL rejects every login from the api.
